sky.qualification: Bestla's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Saturn-system ephemeris; Partial observed south-ecliptic pole latitude and retrograde sense are preserved. Exact pole longitude and current phase remain unknown; ecliptic south is a representative display convention, not the full measured pole. Author body-page pole cells are blank; the primary paper supplies this partial constraint.
provenance.qualification: Computed Bestla Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
